# Copilot instructions

All agent instructions are in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the root, so that each coding agent
sees the same rules. Read it before you make changes.

[`apps/web/AGENTS.md`](../apps/web/AGENTS.md) has the rules for the web app. Read it too when you
change code in `apps/web`.

Do not add project rules to this file. Add them to the nearest `AGENTS.md`.
